title: Improvement team config
description: Schema for <home>/improvement.yaml and <home>/improvement.local.yaml: the keys /improvement:find and /improvement:setup read through the four config-cascade layers. Key contract and merge semantics: plugins/improvement/reference/config.md.

churn_window.description: The hotspot recipe's change-frequency window, a value git log --since accepts.

churn_exclude.description: Extra ERE patterns excluded from churn counting. Unioned across layers.

churn_exclude_defaults.description: false drops the mechanical-file exclusions resolved from the repository, leaving only declared patterns.

find_open_item_cap.description: Per source label: unattended /improvement:find files nothing while the open items carrying it number at or above this. The personal file can only lower it.

find_run_item_cap.description: Where the adaptive per-run filing cap starts.

find_run_item_cap_floor.description: Lowest value the per-run filing cap adapts to.

find_run_item_cap_ceiling.description: Highest value the per-run filing cap adapts to.

find_size_band.description: The candidate sizes an unattended run ranks.

find_scope.description: What an unattended run scans: repo, or a target /improvement:find accepts.

find_suppress_dismissed.description: Whether an unattended run suppresses candidates an operator dismissed before.

evidence_sources.description: Tier 2 application-telemetry declarations, one entry per source name. A null or empty entry in a later layer removes the inherited source.

mcp_server.description: The MCP server as named in the consumer's own MCP configuration.

scope.description: The product surface the source covers.

hints.description: Where to start: key queries, dashboards, or tables worth reading first.
